walkthroughs.body_html:
Diet and Health — a core area of GCSE Home Economics: Food and Nutrition.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Diet and Health brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Diet and Health.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the main function of dietary fibre?
options: Aiding digestion and promoting bowel health.
Energy used to maintain basic bodily functions at complete rest.
The vinegar kills the food cells.
Acidic conditions (low pH) prevent most bacteria from growing.
